name: Result / Artifact Card
hint: Open a card: its frame grows into the panel. Switch versions and watch only what changed move.
description: The things an assistant makes for you (a document, code, a chart, a table) as objects with a life. In the thread each one is a compact card with a live miniature of its real content that fills in while the assistant writes. Opening it grows the card's own frame into a panel that docks beside the thread in wide layouts, covers a chat column, or rises as a draggable bottom sheet on phones; closing shrinks it back into the card. Revisions update the card in place with a version mark and change note, and the panel's version switcher morphs what changed: text crossfades by block, bars move, numbers roll.
intents: show a document or code the AI generated in a side panel
artifact card in a chat thread that opens a canvas
AI result card with versions and a version history switcher
assistant output viewer with copy, download and run
usage: Pass `artifacts` ([{ id, type: document|code|chart|table|yours, title, state, content, versions }]) or a single `artifact`; with no `thread` they show as cards in one assistant message, or pass a `thread` of messages ({ id, role: user|assistant, text, artifacts: [id], refs: [id] }) that place them. Drive it from a stream by updating the artifact: `state` follows the AI SDK (`input-available` → `input-streaming` → `output-available`, or `output-error` with `errorText`), `content` is whatever has arrived so far (blocks, code, points or rows; the renderers draw partial content), and each finished revision is appended to `versions` as { label, note, content }. Control the panel with `open` (an id, or null) / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`, the shown version with `version` / `defaultVersion` / `onVersionChange`, and the presentation with `layout` (auto docks at 860px+, covers narrower containers, and uses a bottom sheet on phones). Add types through `renderers` ({ [type]: { label, glyph, panel, mini, count, text } }). Actions are yours: Download, Run, Stop and Retry appear only when you pass `onDownload`, `onRun`, `onStop` and `onRetry`, each called with the artifact; set `running` (an id) while your run works. Copy is built in and reports through `onCopy({ ok })`. `assistant` ({ name, title, workspace, mark }) adds the header. Nothing is fetched, run or downloaded by the component; the sample conversation sits behind `demo`.

(id: string | null) => void, when a card, a reference, close, Escape or a drag down wants to open or close the panel.

({ artifact, content, text, ok, error }) => void, after the built-in copy to the clipboard succeeds (ok true) or fails (ok false).
